title: Eviction-aware policy scorer with dry-run shadowing and canary sweep
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build an automated scoring and rollout pipeline that recommends KV/prefix cache policies (TTL, eviction priority, key-shaping hints) using a simulation-backed hit-rate model, and validates changes with a dry-run shadowing system plus a controlled canary sweep before safe apply/rollback.
background: We currently have manual recommendations for prefix TTL tuning and cache key shaping that rely on heuristic heuristics and post-hoc monitoring. Teams want automated, low-risk ways to reduce token spend without hurting latency or quality. Previous work produced offline simulators and prefix popularity analyses, but operators still lack a single scoring metric that combines predicted hit-rate uplift, expected cost delta, and rollback confidence. This ticket consolidates modeling, a policy scorer, dry-run plumbing (traffic shadowing), and a canary + rollback orchestration plan.
acceptance_criteria: Scorer produces ranked candidate policies for a target namespace with predicted: hit-rate delta, expected token cost change, 95% confidence interval for hit-rate estimate
Dry-run shadowing pipeline can mirror 1% production traffic for a namespace and record per-request cache outcome without affecting live responses

Canary sweep automation can apply a policy to a subset (by shard/region/customer tier) and evaluate gating metrics (latency P95, error rate, token spend) against thresholds for at least 24h before full apply
Rollback triggers implemented: immediate revert on >3x error rate, >15% latency P95 regression, or token spend exceeding predicted upper CI for 24h
Integration tests (CI) that simulate traffic and verify dry-run metric collection and rollback path executes cleanly
Documentation in Optimize console explaining score, confidence bands, and one-click staged apply/rollback
implementation_plan: Instrumentation: augment request path to emit anonymized prefix/key signals to shadowing pipeline (privacy-preserving hashing)
Modeling: train a Bayesian hit-rate estimator that outputs posterior distributions over prefix hit probability and supports lightweight sampling for CI calculations
Scorer: combine model outputs with cost model (tokens saved per hit, serving cost delta) to compute a single policy score and an expected-cost band
Simulator: augment existing traffic replay to support policy emulation and compute counterfactual hit outcomes for candidate policies
Dry-run infra: build a non-invasive shadowing path that records cache outcomes in a metrics index and a replayable log store (GCS/BigQuery links included below), with rate-limits and budget controls
Canary orchestration: add rollout planner that stages policies across shards/regions with automated checks and automated rollback hooks connected to alerting
UI/CLI: expose top-3 ranked policy recommendations with explainability notes and a button to run dry-run or launch canary
Postmortem hooks: on rollback create automated ticket with summarized deviation metrics and suggested safer candidate policies
risks_and_mitigation: Model miscalibration -> mitigate by using Bayesian priors, stratified holdouts, and runtime calibration checks
Shadowing overhead -> cap mirror rate to 1-2% initially and sample by customer tier; use hashed identifiers to avoid PII
False positives causing unnecessary rollback -> require 3 independent gating metrics and 2-sample confirmation before auto-revert; provide manual-override option
High-variance prefixes (long-tail) -> add minimum-sample thresholds and prefer staged TTL increases for low-sample prefixes
Operational complexity for SRE -> provide runbook and automated diagnostics attachment to generated rollback tickets
progress_updates: 2026-03-02 - Kickoff: scoped deliverables with Product and Console PM. Agreed on initial gating metrics (P95 latency, 5xx rate, token spend delta).
2026-03-04 - Data collection spike: prototype shadowing via kafka topic 'cache-shadow-v1' and captured 48h sample from dev cluster (links below).
2026-03-08 - Modeling spike: implemented Beta-Bernoulli estimator and compared to frequentist MLE on heldout traffic; posterior CI reduces extreme tail errors on small prefixes.
2026-03-11 - Scorer MVP: scoring function merged in feature branch (PR #5123). Produces ranked candidates with expected cost band and top reason strings for UI.
2026-03-12 - Canary orchestration design review with SRE and Product done; agreed canary units = shard x region, default 5% traffic, 24h observation window.
notes_for_reviewers: Focus review on scorer's cost assumptions: token unit cost and hit-value. Seeking feedback on default gating thresholds and whether to expose the CI percentile slider in the UI. Also validate privacy-preserving hashing approach for prefix signals.
